train_svm_low_shot: train a low-shot SVM classifier on extracted features for a given model layer
extract_low_shot_features: extract low-shot features from a trained model for VOC or Places datasets
train_voc07_low_shot: train and evaluate a low-shot SVM on VOC07 dataset with multiple k-values and samples
train_places_low_shot: train and evaluate a low-shot SVM on Places dataset using multiprocessing
hydra_main: run the low-shot SVM training pipeline with Hydra configuration overrides
